Exploratory Data Analysis

Loading our Dataset and Checking dementions

load("12_DataSaving.RData")
source("03_funct_EDA.R")
dim(clean_data)
## [1] 5001   37

Data Preparation

eda_data <- create_low_back_group(clean_data)
table(eda_data$low_back_group, useNA = "ifany")
## 
##   No  Yes <NA> 
## 4025  974    2

Missing Data

variables <- c(
  "back_pain",
  "site_low_back",
  "lumbar_flexion_cm",
  "chest_expansion_cm",
  "occiput_wall_cm"
)

sapply(eda_data[variables], function(x) {
  sum(is.na(x))
})
##          back_pain      site_low_back  lumbar_flexion_cm chest_expansion_cm 
##                  2               3518                336                386 
##    occiput_wall_cm

Summary Statistics

# Lumbar flexion
summary_by_group(eda_data, "lumbar_flexion_cm")
##   Group Count Mean Median   SD
## 1    No  3770 3.91    3.8 1.28
## 2   Yes   893 3.86    3.8 1.31
# Chest expansion
summary_by_group(eda_data, "chest_expansion_cm")
##   Group Count Mean Median   SD
## 1    No  3717  4.6    4.3 1.99
## 2   Yes   896  4.3    4.1 1.89
# Occiput-to-wall distance
summary_by_group(eda_data, "occiput_wall_cm")
##   Group Count Mean Median   SD
## 1    No  3974 0.26      0 1.30
## 2   Yes   962 0.29      0 1.26

Visualizations
